object.attr: as implemented: mapped from the existing tests, with blind tests written from the requirements alone for what they missed.
object.description: Open the Advanced filter dialog for a new filter, name it, and build one filter condition by choosing the attribute priority, the operator eq and the value Must; save. With a filter active, choose New filter… and save a second filter. Open the dialog from the active filter. In the library, replace a filter's filter conditions, combinator and ancestor setting. Expected: the saved filter has the name and exactly the filter condition priority eq Must, and its filter file is written; the second filter gets a new file and the first filter's condition is unchanged; opened from the active filter the dialog starts from that filter, and New filter… starts empty; the replaced filter keeps its name and holds the new conditions, any and no ancestors.
